# ODST Group - Comprehensive Context & Services Guide

> ODST Group is an integrated conglomerate dedicated to premium Hajj & Umrah services, encompassing luxury hospitality, aviation charter, and tailored spiritual travel packages.

## Corporate Identity & Mission
ODST Group bridges Indonesian and Saudi Arabian spiritual tourism with world-class hospitality, transparent operations, and dedicated pilgrim care.

## Core Business Divisions
1. **ODST Hotels**: Managing and curating premier 5-star accommodations in Makkah and Madinah close to Masjidil Haram and Masjid an-Nabawi.
2. **ODST Airlines**: Providing high-capacity private charters, business class flights, and dedicated group aviation solutions connecting Jakarta and Jeddah/Madinah.
3. **ODST Tour & Travel**: Full-service Umrah and Hajj packages with professional mutawwif guides, visa facilitation, catering, and VIP ground transport.

## Official Contact & Channels
- **Email**: info@odst.id
- **Official Website**: https://odst.id
- **Contact Form**: https://odst.id/contact
- **Operating Headquarters**: Jakarta, Indonesia & Operations in Makkah/Madinah/Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
